citations.assessment: The current text names Rabbi Chiyya and Acha son of Rav Avya, matching the cited corrected reading in substance.
Acha bar Avyah transmits in Rav Assi’s name in Rabbi Yochanan’s name.
Attests Acha bar Avya reporting a question asked in the West. Sitting before Assi and the Assi bar Chanina report are not stated there.
Acha son of Rav Avya finds Ashi’s students and asks whether their master addressed the doorway issue.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about benefit from the loaf given as a gift.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about terms used in a vow.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about the parallel derivations from soaked food.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about reciting the verses for first fruits.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about the husband and agent in the case of borrowing.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about the implications of adjoining eruvin.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about Akiva’s source for the substance of flavor.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about the meaning of the building term kefisin.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about the valuation and production of an article.
Acha son of Rav Avya addresses Rav Ashi about the status of an enslaved person in a property sale.
Alternate attributions name Acha son of Rava or Acha son of Rav Avya as the speaker to Ashi.
This citation is to Klal Gadol in Shabbat. The retrieved Bavli names Rav Acha bar Rav Avira.
The Rif running text reads Acha bar Ashi bar Avira, and a footnote explicitly gives Ashi bar Rav Avira as a manuscript reading. Heilprin’s assessment of the reading is preserved as his.
The accessible text indeed names Adda son of Rav Avya. Heilprin calls this an error.
Acha son of Rav Avya objects to Ashi about who carries the burden of proof.
The locator is the internal early-Ashi entry. The identification proposed here is not settled by the dialogues.
The exact reply occurs at 33b, where Rav Chisda speaks to Acha bar Rav Avya. An analogous Shevuot reply addresses Rabbah.
Acha son of Rav Avya directly addresses Rav Menashe.

holds.reason: The reported sitting before Rav Assi and the unlocated transmission from Rav Assi bar Chanina remain qualified.
